stdout:
usage: subagent submit [-h] --task-id TASK_ID [--description DESCRIPTION]
                       --command COMMAND [--mode {direct,supervised}]
                       [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                       [--monitor-interval MONITOR_INTERVAL] [--model MODEL]
                       [--run-dir RUN_DIR] [--cwd CWD]
                       [--override-discussion REASON] [--clear-stop]
                       [--no-preflight] [--cpu-count CPU_COUNT |
                       --cpu-ids CPU_IDS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task-id TASK_ID     Unique task identifier
  --description DESCRIPTION
  --command COMMAND     Shell command to run
  --mode {direct,supervised}
                        direct: just run (no LLM). supervised: run + periodic
                        LLM monitoring
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Max seconds (default: 2h)
  --monitor-interval MONITOR_INTERVAL
                        Base seconds between supervisor checks; backs off
                        while healthy, tightens when degrading (supervised
                        mode)
  --model MODEL         Supervisor model (defaults to configured
                        supervisor/shared model)
  --run-dir RUN_DIR     Run directory whose progress.jsonl/status.json the
                        supervisor reads and where it writes STOP on early-
                        stop
  --cwd CWD
  --override-discussion REASON
                        Break-glass: launch even though a supervisor is parked
                        on an open discussion. Records REASON to the
                        experiment ledger.
  --clear-stop          Remove a leftover run_dir/STOP before launching
                        (otherwise submit refuses a poisoned run dir).
  --no-preflight        Skip the supervised-mode pre-launch RL config
                        preflight (escape hatch for a known-good config).
  --cpu-count CPU_COUNT
                        Lease this many distinct CPUs before creating task/run
                        artifacts; the launched process inherits the selected
                        affinity.
  --cpu-ids CPU_IDS     Lease exact comma-separated CPU ids before launch;
                        conflicts with other participating live subagents are
                        rejected.

usage: subagent wait [-h] --task-id TASK_ID [--timeout TIMEOUT]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --task-id TASK_ID
  --timeout TIMEOUT
